mechanisms.name: Outcome-first dependency compression
mechanisms.instruction: For one existing packet, state observable completion and build a small AND/OR prerequisite graph: all-required vs alternative routes, verified vs unknown edges, authority and resource bounds. Identify shared prerequisites blocking several valuable outcomes. Prefer the cheapest admissible route, not a single lowest skill score or greatest raw graph fanout.
mechanisms.falsifier: Removing the supposed blocker does not advance the intended outcome, or an already feasible cheaper route exists.
mechanisms.deliverable: Bounded graph/receipt inside the existing packet; no new framework or global graph migration.

mechanisms.name: Assumption-directed strategy change
mechanisms.instruction: After failure, isolate the exact assumption contradicted by evidence. Consider reuse, smaller decomposition, different supported provider/substrate, different capability bundle, or explicit stop. Preserve the objective and hard constraints. Choose one materially different route only when its prerequisites are available.
mechanisms.falsifier: New strategy changes only wording, repeats the same failure conditions or expands authority.
mechanisms.deliverable: One blocker fingerprint, failed assumption, selected alternative and disconfirming test.

mechanisms.name: Smallest useful observation
mechanisms.instruction: Ask which lawful observation could change the next decision. Run deterministic checks first, then bounded experiments under existing authority. Separate absence of evidence from impossibility. Where outcomes are not discriminating, stop buying more thought.
mechanisms.falsifier: Both rival explanations predict the same observation, or probe cost exceeds the benefit it could plausibly affect.
mechanisms.deliverable: Two rival hypotheses, predicted differences, cost ceiling and next action for either result.

mechanisms.name: Proof reuse with explicit limits
mechanisms.instruction: Bind receipts to source/dependencies/configuration/model/evaluator versions and scope. A fix or capability is reusable only when required assumptions still match. Changed hashes trigger affected-proof review; identical blobs alone do not prove integrated runtime. Do not re-run unrelated tests without a concrete risk or gate.
mechanisms.falsifier: Reused proof depends on stale environment, hidden context, different caller semantics or exposed holdout.
mechanisms.deliverable: Applicability conditions and evidence dependencies, not an unqualified VERIFIED label.

mechanisms.name: Failure becomes a regression case
mechanisms.instruction: Persist the minimal counterexample, failure class and scope. Reuse it in relevant cheap-worker acceptance tests. A successful repair becomes a candidate reusable mechanism, then follows C03 transfer/evaluator/retention gates before broader promotion.
mechanisms.falsifier: It only passes its own training example, worsens existing behavior or requires relaxing the acceptance standard.
mechanisms.deliverable: Counterexample -> bounded repair -> independent proof -> conditional reuse; no automatic production promotion.

mechanisms.name: Compute buys a specific uncertainty reduction
mechanisms.instruction: Route deterministic work without models where possible. Use cheapest configured capable model for remaining bounded work; escalate only with a minimal counterexample and a question a stronger model can resolve. Never send all checkpoint history by default.
mechanisms.falsifier: Extra tokens, agents or model strength produce no independently measured incremental benefit.
mechanisms.deliverable: Actual model/cost where observable, uncertainty before/after and stop reason; unknown budget remains unknown.

mechanisms.name: Restartable work, not chat dependence
mechanisms.instruction: Persist exact refs, owner acknowledgement, occurrence identity, pending effects, evidence, next single action and claim expiry before context loss. Resume by refreshing relevant differences. If a prior external effect is uncertain, reconcile it before retry. No durable storage receipt means no durability claim.
mechanisms.falsifier: Fresh session needs hidden conversation, duplicates an effect or mistakes a proposed owner for a running worker.
mechanisms.deliverable: Small checkpoint linked from CURRENT_HANDOFF; secrets and personal payloads excluded.

capabilities.name: Model Router
capabilities.acceptance: Authority/privacy first; eligible models by task and fresh quality/cost/latency evidence; actual provider identity and fallback reason logged. Budget bounded; exhausted providers not retried blindly. Same prompt on stronger model is not a guaranteed remedy.

capabilities.name: Semantic Cache
capabilities.acceptance: Exact cache first; semantic cache only for permitted low-risk deterministic-enough answers. Key tenant/auth scope, prompt/model/tool/schema/retrieval revisions and freshness. Similarity alone never validates facts, permission, money, mutable state or effects. Test false hits, stale evidence, deletion and tenant isolation; monitor correctness and cost savings, not hit rate alone.

capabilities.name: Agent Orchestrator
capabilities.acceptance: Deterministic explicit states, transitions, bounded tasks, ownership/leases, admission and receipts. Reuse existing machine; no LangChain dependency required by proposal and no framework rewrite justified by preference alone.

capabilities.name: MCP Server and Client
capabilities.acceptance: Inspect existing endpoint and actual missing client operations. Raw JSON-RPC/no-SDK is a requested design candidate, not a completeness guarantee. Before implementation consult current official protocol; test negotiated version, initialization, request IDs, errors, cancellation, transport lifecycle and authentication. Reject unsolicited callbacks/redirects and unauthorized tool effects. Prefer maintaining a minimal correct subset over claiming whole protocol parity.

capabilities.name: Multi-Agent Consensus
capabilities.acceptance: Weighted voting remains hypothesis. Calibrate weights on held-out errors and source ancestry; correlated copies cannot multiply confidence. Independent executable checks first; compare against one strong/cheap baseline at equal budget; judge must abstain and escalation remain bounded.

capabilities.name: Sandboxed Tool Executor
capabilities.acceptance: Verify actual OS isolation, scoped filesystem/network/credentials, CPU/memory/process/time/output caps and kill cleanup. A subprocess or container label alone is not a security boundary. No host Docker socket; probe escape, fork/output storms and exfiltration using synthetic secrets on owned test hosts.

capabilities.name: Guardrails Middleware
capabilities.acceptance: Input/output/tool-result boundaries, untrusted retrieval, structured argument checks, least privilege and redaction. Injection detector is defense-in-depth, never proof of safety. Test indirect injection, multilingual PII and false positives with synthetic data; redaction preserves necessary meaning and never logs original secrets.

capabilities.name: Durable Workflow Engine
capabilities.acceptance: Reuse existing queue/admission; durable occurrences, checkpoint/version migration, retry/reconciliation, cancellation and compensation. Crash-before/after-effect cases against real test persistence. Mini-Temporal is a bounded behavior objective, not authorization to build or claim a Temporal replacement.

capabilities.name: Streaming Proxy
capabilities.acceptance: Only if an existing endpoint needs it: SSE framing, cancellation, backpressure, bounded buffers, timeout and disconnect cleanup. Mark partial vs completed output. Do not replay a streamed tool effect on reconnect. Measure TTFT and token interval only where tokenizer/token timestamps justify the name; otherwise report event intervals.

capabilities.name: LLM Tracer
capabilities.acceptance: Reuse existing logging/receipts before new backend. Correlate task -> retrieval -> route -> model -> tool -> workflow with parent/span IDs, monotonic duration, retries, actual tokens/cost or unknown. Redact by default, sample boundedly; tracing failure must not duplicate effects. Trace summaries must distinguish external wall time from model latency.

capabilities.name: Eval Harness
capabilities.acceptance: Inventory existing tests/harness before building. Version task sets and trajectories; independent verifiable outcomes plus cost/latency/authority constraints. Held-out answers excluded from generator context, graders not self-edited; CI regression gate tests intended assertion and identifies skipped/unexecuted runs.

capabilities.name: Prompt Registry
capabilities.acceptance: Use current git-backed prompts as registry baseline. Bind immutable prompt/template/tool/schema versions, approvals and rollback. A/B route only eligible low-risk cases with stable experiment IDs; record model/retrieval confounders. No automatic exposure of private data or customer experiment from registry setup.

capabilities.acceptance: Feedback with provenance/consent -> validated failure taxonomy -> counterexamples/evals -> prompt/retrieval/tool repair first. Synthetic data is labelled, deduped, leakage-screened and never ground truth by generation. LoRA only for a supported accessible model, licensed usable data, compute budget and a demonstrated baseline bottleneck; isolated training, held-out retention/safety/cost evaluation and rollback. No implied ability to fine-tune proprietary hosted models.
